ja_kana: せいれいおうルクランバ
ocg_text: A reptilian creature that is said to be the ruler of all spirits. It is a rare being that is not commonly seen.
An earth angel that has a rare quality about its style. It prefers to fight with weapons rather than magic.

ja_kana: ラスオブタスク・マンモス
ocg_text: An imposing mammoth with a massive pair of curved tusks. Its hairy coat provides a superb level of protection.

ja_kana: コマンド・エンジェル
ocg_text: A combative Angel that, while on the own field, powers up all Angels on the same field.
Negates any level-reducing Magic used on the player's monsters. It restores the levels of the player's monsters on the field.

ja_kana: てんしのトランペット
ocg_text: An angel on a trumpet, whose sweet notes ring clearly far away. It uplifts and powers up an Angel.

ja_kana: せんねんのたてのぎしき
ocg_text: A ritual for summoning a tough shield in return for a Release. For this ritual, a "One-Eyed Shield Dragon", etc., is needed.
A ritual for summoning a "Yamadran" in return for a Release. For this ritual, a "Mountain Warrier", etc., is needed.

ja_base: ゲート・ガーディアンのぎ式
ja_kana: ゲート・ガーディアンのぎしき
ocg_text: A ritual for summoning a "Gate Guardian" in return for Releases. For this ritual, "Thunder Devil - Sanga", "Wind Devil - Hyuga", and "Water Devil - Suga" are needed.

ja_kana: きゅうきょくりゅうのぎしき
ocg_text: Summons a "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon" with Releases. For this ritual, three "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" are needed.

ja_kana: せんねんげんじんのふっかつ
ocg_name: Revival of the Millennium Primitive Man
ocg_text: A ritual for summoning a "Millennium Primitive Man" in return for Releases. For this, two monsters and a "Cyclops" are needed.

ja_kana: さんぼんつののぎしき
ocg_text: A ritual for summoning a "Tri-Horn Dragon" with a Release. For this ritual, a "Black Dragon King of the Jungle", etc., is needed.
A Trap Card that is deadly to stronger monsters that attack it. If the monster's ATK is 1,500 or less, the trap wipes it out.
A Trap Card that is deadly to strong monsters that attack it. If the monster's ATK is 2,000 or less, the trap wipes it out.

ja_base: エビルナイト・ドラゴンの復活
ja_kana: エビルナイト・ドラゴンのふっかつ
ocg_text: A ritual for summoning an "Evil Knight Dragon" with a Release. For this, a "Dark Blaze Dragon", etc., is needed.
A ritual for summoning a "Mask of Darkness and Light" with Releases. For this, two monsters and a "Mask of Darkness" are needed.
A ritual for summoning a "Killer Puppet" in return for a Release. For this, a "Mysterious Marionettist", etc., is needed.

ja_kana: コスモクイーンのいのり
ocg_text: A ritual for summoning a "Cosmo Queen" in return for a Release. For this, a "Queen of Autumn Leaves", etc., is needed.
A malevolent puppet that performs odd, debilitating dances. Its dancing inflicts pain on those that see it.

ja_kana: やみとひかりのかめん
ocg_text: A sinister mask that uses illusions to confuse its foes. It creates a swirling vision of dark and light.
A robot that is constructed primarily with sets of semicircles. It attacks with lasers mounted at its sides and the center.
A fiendish doll that was once beloved, but discarded later. It came to life to exact revenge for abandonment.
A dark warrior that has assumed the guise of a caped sword. It cleaves everything it touches in half.
A warrior who uses a steel fan that is etched with a dragon. He battles as if he were dancing.
A beast warrior that breathes on the neck of its foe. The startled foe is then shredded by this quick being.
An ant that turned vicious as a result of spontaneous mutation. Its body is relatively stiff and durable.
An aquatic serpent that crawls along the bottom of the sea. It suddenly appears and attacks when it spots prey.
A Magic that causes the exclusion of a monster to darkness. If attacked, it destroys a monster on the foe's field.
